sentences.en: Someday I will repay him for looking down on me.
sentences.zh: 总有一天我会回报他轻视我的行为。

sentences.en: Your lack of sleep will catch up with you someday.
sentences.zh: 你迟早会因为睡眠不足而付出代价。

sentences.en: In Belgium, Flemish people want to declare their independence someday.
sentences.zh: 在比利时，弗拉芒人希望有朝一日宣布独立。

senses.zh: 将来会有一天，有朝一日
